title: Medusa: Simple LLM Inference Acceleration Framework with Multiple Decoding Heads
grouping: Three tall rounded containers in one row with pastel fills and a title at the top of each: a blue-to-purple gradient 'Original Model', a pink-red 'Medusa Heads' and a lilac 'Top-k Predictions'. Below them a row of grey rounded boxes (Input, Candidates, Single step prediction). A mascot logo sits above the middle container.
shapes_depth: White rounded rectangles with thin dark outlines inside the containers; the model stack reads bottom-to-top (Embedding, Transformer Layers, LM Head), then one 'Last Hidden' line fans out by right-angled arrows to three identical head boxes, each wired left-to-right to its own box of top-k token text ('is, ', the'). Text tokens are plain words, no token chips. Small emoji icons sit in titles (snowflake/flame, a document, a pencil); the candidate list uses a green tick and red crosses beside each candidate continuation, with the accepted prefix in bold.
proposed_highlight: The new heads are the middle container in the only warm (pink-red) fill, each a numbered copy of one box; trainable versus frozen parts are marked by a flame icon and a snowflake/flame pair in the container titles.
lesson: Mark frozen and trained parts with snowflake and flame icons in the container titles, and draw the added prediction heads as a stack of identical numbered boxes, each wired to its own row of top-k token text, so 'one head per future position' reads at a glance.
notes: Venue and year from the PDF footer ('Proceedings of the 41st International Conference on Machine Learning ... PMLR 235, 2024'). The embedded logo is a raster image.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

taxonomy.task: LLM inference acceleration with extra decoding heads

core.what: one 'Last Hidden' state from the original model's Transformer Layers fans right into three stacked Medusa Heads beside the LM Head, each head feeding its own row of top-k tokens in a column on the right

relations.form: a single line leaves Transformer Layers labelled 'Last Hidden' and branches with right-angled turns into Medusa Head 1, 2 and 3, while the same output also goes up into the LM Head

inside the blue 'Original Model' container the flow runs bottom to top (Input box, Embedding, Transformer Layers, LM Head); the bottom row then runs left to right from Input to Candidates to Single step prediction

four parallel head-to-row lanes: the LM Head and Medusa Heads 1-3 each send one horizontal arrow into its own row of the purple Top-k Predictions column ('It, I, As'; 'is, ', the'; 'difficult, is, ''; 'not, difficult, a'), every row level with its head
a line from the bottom of the Top-k column drops into the Candidates box, which lists combined continuations with green check / red cross marks before the Single step prediction 'It is difficult'

channels.colour: container tint = role (blue original model, red added Medusa heads, purple predictions, grey data boxes); snowflake / flame icons = frozen / trained
channels.shape: rounded white boxes = modules or token rows; grey rounded boxes with icons = data (input, candidates, output)
channels.frame: rounded tinted container = one component group

quality.strengths: the added part is the only red container and sits between the base model and its outputs; each head's prediction row is level with the head so the one-to-one mapping reads by position; data is drawn as real quoted tokens and candidate continuations with accept/reject marks
quality.weaknesses: the llama mascot logo takes the top-centre space and carries nothing; the shared 'Last Hidden' wire bends three times to reach the heads; how candidates are verified (the tree attention) is not drawn, only the selected result

insights.structure: Three rounded tinted containers left to right: blue 'Original Model' (Embedding, Transformer Layers, LM Head stacked bottom-up), red 'Medusa Heads' (three stacked numbered heads) and purple 'Top-k Predictions' (one text row per head), with three grey boxes along the bottom for Input, Candidates and Single step prediction.
insights.data: Tokens are shown as quoted text: a real question in the Input box, comma-separated top-k tokens per head ('is, ', the'), and candidate continuations with green-check / red-cross marks.
insights.emphasis: The added heads sit in the only red container with a flame icon in its title, while snowflake / flame icons on the original model mark it as frozen or trained.
insights.flow: Input rises into the original model, 'Last Hidden' fans right into each Medusa head, each head (and the LM head) feeds its own row of top-k tokens, then a return arrow drops into Candidates and on to the final single-step prediction at bottom right.
insights.avoid: The decorative llama-logo mascot at top centre carries no information and takes prime space.

arrangement.units: three rounded tinted containers in a row (base model, added heads, predictions) plus a bottom row of grey boxes for input, candidates and output
arrangement.inputs_as: a grey box with a quoted question
